conviction_note: The 月次 already show H1 sales up about 12% (domestic Q2 about +14%), so sales are not the news. The open question is whether profit keeps up with sales. My estimate from the company's own documents is Q2 OP up about 10% (domestic up, China and ASEAN down), with H1 経常 lapping a large Q2 2025 FX gain. Against that, the company's sales plan implies H2 sales falling about 1% YoY, which leaves room for an upward revision of the sales line. Netted, that is a slight negative lean (p_up 47) on the name's ~5% reaction scale, giving -0.3 scaled against an impact_sum of -0.5. Both are small because three of the four non-zero findings are inferences built on series the market already has.
bar: IFIS consensus FY2027/02 OP 7,500m yen (sales 95,000m, 経常 6,500m), dated 2026-04-08, single source and six months stale: https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/4343_20260409_act_20260409_133010_2 . IFIS (kabuyoho) shows no current consensus: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=4343 . The company gives no H1 guide, only the full year (OP 8,000m). The pace bar is 3,630m H1 2025 x (7,500/6,114) = about 4,450m. My H1 OP estimate is about 3,950-4,000m, so roughly -10%. The bar is single-source and stale and the seasonal share is unstable (H1 share of FY OP was 56%/66%/59% over the last three years), so every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the baseline). 信用倍率 6.18, so retail margin longs are crowded, which is the setup in which a disappointing Q2 still has sellers. No options, no skew. Run-up 20d +0.29%, 5d +3.2%. The stock is about 6% below its 2026-08-21 high of 2,905 and drifted lower after the August 月次 (Yahoo chart). Baseline priced_lean -0.41, almost all from margin overhang.

findings.finding: Domestic profit conversion risk. In Q1 domestic sales rose 11.3% but domestic OP fell 6.5% (1,258m), which the company attributed to opening costs for new formats. Q2 added 15 more domestic openings, 8 of them in July and mostly the costly new formats (クレーン横丁 極, のびっこジャンボ, ちきゅうのにわ). Growth is also shifting toward lower-margin prize and merchandise, while the highest-margin medal department ran discount events. On last year's Q2 domestic margin (12.8%) less Q1's compression, Q2 domestic OP comes out around +5% to +20% on about +14% sales.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last H1 print (2025-10-14, 15:30): H1 OP +26.5% but Q2 OP only +1.0%, and the stock had already fallen on 10-14 then fell sharply again (kabutan 2025-10-15; baseline estimated -10.12%). The Q1 2026 print (OP +9.3%) was met with about +5-8% (baseline +5.31).
findings.why_not_priced: The 月次 publish sales only, never profit. The visible series (domestic sales +14% in Q2, store openings, new formats 120-230% of plan) reads bullish, and retail margin longs at 6.18x are positioned on it. If the market had priced margin compression, the stock would have sold off on the strong July and August 月次 rather than rising on the July release (kabutan 2026-08-18).
findings.independence: Same document family. The opening counts and department mix come from the company's monthly (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260817/140120260817521770.pdf, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260915/140120260915536609.pdf). The analogue is last year's H1 print (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4343&b=n202510150632). Counter-evidence from the same 月次: SSS accelerated in Q2 (adjusted 106.5/110.7/110.1 against Q1's 105.4/104.1/102.3), and Q2 had fewer openings than Q1 (15 vs 28), so the Q2 domestic margin may well beat Q1's.

findings.finding: Overseas deteriorated in Q2. China same-store sales were 76.3/72.5/85.5% in Jun/Jul/Aug (H1 87.2%) after 108-111% in Mar/Apr, and overseas total was 92.7/91.0/97.5%. The FY plan asks overseas OP to swing +1,402m to +500m. Q1 overseas OP was only +78m, so the Q2 overseas loss is likely to be wider than last year's roughly -148m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-02-17: the stock fell on overseas January SSS of -5.2% (kabutan n202602170203). Last H1 print: kabutan/Fisco attributed the Q2 2025 stall to ASEAN profit weakness and the stock fell.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the overseas SSS have been public monthly. The part that is not in the price is the profit translation and whether management signals that the overseas OP target of +500m is out of reach. If that were priced, the stock would not have held around 2,640-2,740 through the August 月次 release. Rule 1 applies, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: FY plan by segment (overseas sales 17,300m -4.3%, OP 500m): https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260409/140120260409500813.pdf . Same issuer, a different document.

findings.finding: Sales are running far above the full-year plan. H1 sales come to about 52bn yen (Q1 24,575m plus Q2 at about +12%) against a FY plan of 98,000m, which implies H2 sales about -1% YoY. The plan also sits above IFIS's 95,000m. That leaves room for an upward revision of the sales line, or of OP on the domestic side. But in each of the last three years the company kept its plan at H1 and cut late (Feb/Apr), so the default is a held plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No H1 revision in FY24, FY25 or FY26 (kabuyoho revision table). The last revision (2026-04-06, 経常 raised) was followed by a six-session rally (kabutan n202604070255).
findings.why_not_priced: Without a current consensus, nobody publishes the arithmetic that the plan implies falling H2 sales. A revision would be new information in the same TDnet batch. If it were priced, the stock would be trading at or above its August high rather than about 6% below it.
findings.independence: Segment plan and H1 monthly cumulative (+12.9% domestic vs plan +7.3%): https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260409/140120260409500813.pdf and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260915/140120260915536609.pdf

findings.finding: Q2 経常 faces a high base. Q2 2025 経常 was 2,831m against OP of 2,408m, so about +423m of non-operating income, mostly FX gains. Between 2026-05-29 and 08-31 the yen barely moved (USD +0.3%, MYR -1.1%, THB -1.5%, CNY +1.1%), so the Q2 2026 FX line is likely near zero. If so, Q2 経常 prints flat to down YoY even with OP up, which is the line kabutan's automated headline leads with.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026: FX gain of 547m lifted 経常 to +173% and the stock rose. Last H1: 経常 +70% and the stock still fell, because the market read Q2 OP.
findings.why_not_priced: Translating FX into this company's non-operating line is my own inference (FX from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/JPY=X), and the exposure mix is not disclosed. Because it sits below OP it is sized as a fraction.
findings.independence: The Q1 FX-gain notice explains the mechanism: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591476.pdf

findings.finding: The interim dividend of 10 yen (vs 0 a year ago; FY 20 yen vs 15) is planned and is likely confirmed with the H1 release. With an equity ratio of 11.6% there is no visible capacity for a buyback.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The +5 yen dividend increase was announced with the FY results on 2026-04-09 (kabutan k202604090010). No return changes were made at the last two H1 prints.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the dividend was guided in April and reaffirmed at Q1. It is filed as the strongest positive that is certain, and it is worth zero.

outside_window.finding: The September 月次 (domestic and overseas SSS) is likely published after the window. Last year the September figures came at 15:30 the day after the H1 print (2025-10-15), so this year that would be 10-14 15:30 or later.

The Q1 決算短信 on 2026-07-10 and the Q3 one on 2026-01-08 were also both stamped 15:30 on the kabutan TDnet list. The FY release was at 13:30, but that was the full-year print. Date 2026-10-13 is confirmed independently by IFIS/kabuyoho ('次回発表予定 中間決算：2026/10/13').
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely, because the company has held its plan at H1 for three straight years and cuts late; sales are running ahead of plan, so a sales-only raise is the upside tail. Returns: the 10 yen interim was already guided; no buyback capacity. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: H1 OP was about 50% of the plan in the last two years (2,870/5,700, 3,630/7,300); this year's estimate of about 3,950-4,000/8,000 is about 49-50%, in line.

rejected_candidates.candidate: New-format stores (クレーン横丁 極) running at 120-230% of plan in August
rejected_candidates.detail: A sales-side counterweight to the domestic margin finding; folded into its independence field rather than counted separately.

baseline_tension: Roughly agrees with the baseline's mildly negative lean (-0.41 from the crowded margin long) and cuts against nothing in the flat 20d run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY plan with a raised sales line (plan implies H2 sales -1% YoY) plus a confirmed 10 yen interim. I looked for a buyback, 優待 change and pre-filed revision and found none. The price has not run into this print the way it did in 2025, which makes a repeat of last year's -10% less likely.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative on a series the market already has): overseas SSS finding cut from -0.5 to -0.3, and the domestic margin inference from -0.5 to -0.4, because both rest on public 月次/短信; the FX-base finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2; p_up moved from 45 to 47.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): the strongest positive (sales running above a plan that implies falling H2 sales, plus the confirmed interim dividend) is written into baseline_tension. I had already looked for a buyback and a 優待 change, so this moved nothing further.
Left standing: the sales-revision upside (+0.4), abs_move_pct 5.0, and print_vs_bar -10.
